Hello, I'm
Rejaul Ali.

PhD Research Scholar in Electrical & Electronics Engineering at BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus.

01 / Introduction

About me

I am a doctoral researcher at BITS Pilani working broadly in electronic devices and emerging technologies. My work includes experimental investigation, characterization, data analysis and scientific communication.

I am interested in connecting with researchers, academic groups and technology teams working on challenging interdisciplinary problems.
